assessment: The prior prevalence overgeneralization is repaired: K0005 now uses full-corpus counts, correctly separates D16/D18 frequency from D17 uncertainty, and K0003/K0007 preserve the distinction between corpus non-observation, taxonomy coverage, and real-world novelty. The synthesis also uses E0007 rather than bypassing the Evidence layer for candidate A–F. A remaining comparability defect concerns candidate-side Dimension coverage, however. The pinned upstream candidate hypotheses explicitly assign only a subset of D07–D18 and do not assign D08, D12, D14, or D21, while K0006 and downstream framing imply a broader D07–D18/D21 comparison envelope. The unassigned dimensions must be surfaced as unavailable/unresolved rather than silently included in the comparative range.

findings.target: 20_synthesis.K0006 and candidate-side Dimension comparability carried into 30_analysis

findings.impact: The main D07–D10 and D16/D18 conclusions remain supported, but the Investigation does not yet give a faithful Dimension-wise account of which requested dimensions are comparable versus unassigned. D08, D12, D14, and D21 can be mistaken as having been compared when candidate-side assignments are absent, so the RQ-level comparison is methodologically incomplete.
